hook: 17 researchers just reached Nikumaroro Island to solve the 1937 disappearance of Amelia Earhart.

sections.voiceover: 17 researchers just reached Nikumaroro Island to solve the 1937 disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
b_roll: Aerial view of remote Nikumaroro Island in the South Pacific
Archival photo of Amelia Earhart beside her plane

sections.voiceover: Purdue University and the Archaeological Legacy Institute launched the mission. 830 nautical miles of open ocean separated the crew from the target. Where lies the Lockheed Electra 10E?
b_roll: Research vessel cutting through ocean waves
Map tracing an 830 nautical mile voyage across the Pacific
Blueprint schematic of a Lockheed Electra 10E aircraft

sections.voiceover: Yet the Lockheed Electra 10E remains missing.
b_roll: Faded historical newspaper clippings about the 1937 disappearance
Modern sonar equipment scanning deep ocean waters

sections.voiceover: Teams arrived in Kiribati after five days at sea. Teams search Nikumaroro Island. Purdue University brought high-tech gear.
b_roll: Expedition members arriving on the shores of Kiribati
Divers descending into blue water near coral reefs
Advanced mapping monitors displaying underwater terrain

sections.voiceover: 17 experts investigate the waters of Nikumaroro.
b_roll: Researchers working on the deck of the expedition ship at sunset
